description: Rank Coin Clash factions by their all-time war record. Returns `board`: factions sorted by wins then power, each with `token`, `symbol`, `image`, `members`, `w`/`l`/`d` (win/loss/draw), `battles`, cumulative `power`, and `winRate` (percent of decided battles won, or null if none decided yet). Pass `faction` (a faction mint) to also get `soldiers`: that faction's top rally contributors this round (wallet + power). Live data — records update as rounds settle. Use this to find the strongest armies and the heaviest hitters.

faction.description: Optional faction mint to also return that faction's top soldiers this round.

name: get_clash_leaderboard
title: Coin Clash leaderboard
